scope: Actual runtime discovery/entry/position scheduling, session ownership, primary Jupiter batch freshness and task shutdown; not market profitability or comprehensive provider acceptance

source_findings.position_monitor_starvation: main_loop previously finished discovery, PumpFun, a complete hot batch and the legacy validation batch before its one _check_positions call. Per-token awaits and timeouts accumulated before any position protection. Runner turbo changed only the final sleep, not that accumulated queue latency
source_findings.stale_hot_batch: HotQueue.pop_batch removed and age-checked a whole batch before serial async evaluation. The untouched tail could become stale or miss a newer snapshot while no longer being pending; evaluated-at timestamps reflected bulk extraction rather than actual service
source_findings.legacy_fairness: obtener_pares returned the same insertion-order eligible prefix. A timeout or no-op at its head could repeatedly delay peers; there was no incremental cycle service budget or independent monitor
source_findings.unused_retry: The legacy fallback condition required use_gt=false and the exact conjunction that had just set use_gt=true, so it could never run. The actual first-call Gecko eligibility remains; the misleading unreachable retry was removed
source_findings.primary_batch_cache: _prefetch_batch_prices used ordinary Jupiter OK/NIL caches, whose default OK TTL is 120 seconds. A one-second runner turbo target could repeatedly consume an old entry price as a new observation
source_findings.task_lifetime: asyncio.gather did not itself cancel and drain sibling loops after one failed. Social enrichment tasks had no explicit owned shutdown or terminal-error consumer. Persisted stopped state could be published before owned work was drained
source_findings.buy_outcome_boundary_remaining: The evaluation timeout spans buyer execution and the later SQL position commit. No buy-side durable intent/replay currently proves recovery across that boundary. Paper portfolio persistence is best-effort direct JSON writing; the live buyer also catches a managed-swap exception and can fall back/retry without proving the earlier execution absent. These distinct integrity paths remain unimplemented in this scheduling stage

implemented.independent_position_owner: One separately supervised serial position-monitor loop waits for initial reconciliation/bootstrap readiness, then owns a fresh SQLAlchemy session per tick. Entry/provider/report awaits no longer postpone the monitor merely by being ahead of it in main_loop. Slow monitor ticks never overlap or create catch-up bursts. Health advances only after a completed session/tick
implemented.entry_and_startup_session_isolation: The startup session is scoped and closed on success/failure. Production entry decisions own separate scoped sessions; exceptions and timeouts dispose/rollback that session without poisoning the next entry or sharing it with the monitor. Explicit caller-owned session compatibility remains for controlled callers
implemented.incremental_opportunity_service: The hot queue is popped one candidate just before actual evaluation with dynamic expansion disabled only for that single pop; untouched candidates remain pending and can receive fresh updates. Both hot and legacy queue cycles admit new work up to the existing item limits and a SLEEP_SECONDS scheduling budget. In-flight evaluations are not cancelled to satisfy this budget. Legacy eligible addresses rotate without spending retries or changing absolute expiry/cooldown metadata and are evaluated at most once per cycle. New same-address hot snapshots remain eligible; configured item limits above 100 are preserved
implemented.primary_price_freshness: The actual position prefetch calls get_many_usd_prices(force_refresh=True), bypassing both Jupiter OK and NIL entry caches. Returned prices must be positive finite nonboolean numbers for an explicitly requested mint. Existing Jupiter throttle remains; no synthetic price or quote is introduced. Cached fallback-provider paths are not certified fresh by this change
implemented.owned_shutdown: The critical-loop supervisor propagates a failed/ended/cancelled loop and cancels/drains its siblings. _runner also cancels/drains retained report/wallet tasks, tracked social enrichment and entry-research tasks before marking/publishing stopped. Social cancellation clears semaphore waiters/inflight ownership without recording a fabricated completed request; terminal errors are consumed
implemented.preserved_trading_contracts: Exact 0.1 SOL paper orders, learned admission allowlists, security/route/impact guards, capital and lane limits, estimated-cost quoted accounting and uncapped runner percentage upside remain. No live flag, active model, runtime selection or market cohort was activated
